> cloud-ru-ai-agents-skills — AI-agent skill + markdown docs for Cloud.ru Object Storage (S3-compatible, endpoint s3.cloud.ru).
> Start with SKILL.md (agent instructions: decision tree, pitfalls, method catalogue). Faithful to https://cloud.ru/docs/s3e/ug/topics/api__methods-object.

- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): agent entrypoint — connect/auth info, decision tree, 11-method catalogue, pitfalls.
- [README.md](README.md): human landing page — install as agent skill, method index, lifecycle diagram, roadmap.

Buckets:
- [methods/list-buckets.md](methods/list-buckets.md): GET / — lists buckets created by the caller; XML ListAllMyBucketsResult.
- [methods/create-bucket.md](methods/create-bucket.md): PUT /{bucket} — creates a bucket; empty body; 200 OK, Location header.
- [methods/delete-bucket.md](methods/delete-bucket.md): DELETE /{bucket} — deletes a bucket; ALL objects must be deleted first.

Objects:
- [methods/put-object.md](methods/put-object.md): PUT /{bucket}/{key} — adds an object; 100-continue; ETag; x-amz-meta-*.
- [methods/get-object.md](methods/get-object.md): GET /{bucket}/{key} — object body; ?versionId selects a version.
- [methods/head-object.md](methods/head-object.md): HEAD /{bucket}/{key} — metadata only; ?partNumber, ?versionId.
- [methods/copy-object.md](methods/copy-object.md): PUT /{bucket}/{key} with x-amz-copy-source — server-side copy.
- [methods/delete-object.md](methods/delete-object.md): DELETE /{bucket}/{key} — per-key delete; ?versionId; 204 even if absent.
- [methods/delete-objects.md](methods/delete-objects.md): DELETE /{bucket} — batch delete of objects.
- [methods/list-objects.md](methods/list-objects.md): GET /{bucket} — legacy listing; prefix, delimiter, key-marker, max-keys, encoding-type.
- [methods/list-objects-v2.md](methods/list-objects-v2.md): GET /{bucket}?list-type=2 (required) — recommended listing; KeyCount, IsTruncated.
